note: WHO has published no SMART DAK for surgery, so this baseline applies the DAK structure to standards assembled by hand. Every entry cites a source that can be checked. Where a source is known to decompose further than an entry here does, the entry says so rather than inventing the decomposition: the WHO SSI guideline states that it contains 29 recommendations on 23 topics, but the per-recommendation titles are not in any source vendored in this repository, so SSI is declared at phase level plus the one topic the WHO publication page names. Decomposing it properly requires vendoring the guideline under docs/reference/who-dak/ with a manifest hash, which is recorded as a follow-up, not silently skipped.

standards.title: Emergency, critical and operative care is one continuum, from community recognition and first aid through emergency unit care to surgical and anaesthesia services in theatre and beyond

standards.title: Sign In — completed before induction of anaesthesia
standards.sourceCitation: WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, 19 items in three phases. WHO Safe Surgery Saves Lives, 2009; phase definition confirmed in Haynes et al., N Engl J Med 2009;360:491-499. https://www.who.int/teams/integrated-health-services/quality-of-care-and-patient-safety/patient-safety-guidance-and-tools/safe-surgery/tool-and-resources

standards.title: Time Out — completed before skin incision, and specifying anticipated critical events
standards.sourceCitation: WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, 2009. Phase anchored before skin incision.

standards.title: Sign Out — completed before the patient leaves the operating room, including instrument, sponge and needle counts and specimen labelling
standards.sourceCitation: WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, 2009. Timing evidence on final wound closure: Boaz et al., BJS Open 2021;5(3):zrab028. https://academic.oup.com/bjsopen/article/5/3/zrab028/6271349

standards.title: The checklist comprises 19 items across the three phases
standards.sourceCitation: WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, 2009, 19 items. The individual item texts are not vendored in this repository; see the note on this baseline.

standards.title: Postoperative measures for the prevention of surgical site infection, including surgical antibiotic prophylaxis discontinuation and wound surveillance
